59	async def post_stock_valuation_journal(session: AsyncSession, event: StockValued) -> None:
60	    """Post the COGS/inventory journal for a valued stock move (D-020), in the move's transaction.
61	
62	    Registered via ``app.main.register_event_handlers`` (the deterministic D-011 registration seam),
63	    not an import-time ``@on`` decorator, so the test harness can re-register it after its per-test
64	    ``clear_subscriptions`` reset (D-025) without relying on a module re-import.
65	
66	    Builds the signed postings for the move type, turns them into balanced one-sided journal lines,
67	    posts a COGS-typed entry dated the move date (the period trigger fires here — a closed period
68	    rolls the whole move back), and links move.document -> entry.document ('posts')."""
69	    currency_code = (
70	        await finance_queries.functional_currency_or_none(session, event.tenant_id)
71	        or DEFAULT_COSTING_CURRENCY
72	    )
73	    # total_cost is already quantized for ISSUE (per-layer / MAV quantize) but a RECEIPT's
74	    # qty × unit_cost can carry sub-currency digits — quantize the posted amount at the boundary
75	    # (D-015); the residual flush is already an exact MoneyType difference.
76	    amount = quantize_for_currency(Decimal(event.total_cost), currency_code)
77	    residual = Decimal(event.residual_to_price_difference)
78	
79	    postings = _postings_for(event, amount, residual)
80	    lines = _lines_from_postings(postings, event.item_id)
81	    if len(lines) < 2:
82	        # A zero-value move (e.g. a free receipt) produces no balanced entry — nothing to post. The
83	        # quant/valuation still updated; there is simply no GL effect. (Not reachable on priced
84	        # moves.)
85	        return
86	
87	    entry = await create_draft_entry(
88	        session,
89	        event.tenant_id,
90	        JournalEntryCreate(
91	            posting_date=date.fromisoformat(event.move_date),
92	            currency_code=currency_code,
93	            description=f"Stock {event.move_type.lower()} {event.move_number}",
94	            document_type=DocumentType.COGS,
95	            lines=lines,
96	        ),
97	    )
98	    await post_entry(session, event.tenant_id, entry.id)
99	    # Link the move's document to the journal entry's document so the docflow chain shows the COGS
100	    # posting (D-012 'posts' edge — the finance posting convention).
101	    await docflow.link_documents(
102	        session,
103	        event.tenant_id,
104	        predecessor=event.document_id,
105	        successor=entry.document_id,
106	        link_type=STOCK_MOVE_POSTS_LINK,
107	    )
108	
109	
110	def _postings_for(
111	    event: StockValued, amount: Decimal, residual: Decimal
112	) -> list[_SignedPosting]:
113	    """The signed GL postings (positive = debit, negative = credit) for the move (D-020).
114	
115	    The costing engine already chose ``offset_account_id`` per move type (ISSUE -> COGS; RECEIPT /
116	    ADJUSTMENT -> price-difference; a reversal -> the opposite of the original's offset), so the
117	    handler stays a thin Dr/Cr direction switch:
118	    - inbound: Dr inventory / Cr offset (stock entered or an issue was reversed).
119	    - outbound: Dr offset / Cr inventory (stock left or a receipt was reversed). The inventory leg
120	      additionally carries the moving-average zero-quantity residual, flushed to price-difference,
121	      so value and quantity reconcile to zero (D-020). ``residual`` is 0 unless the issue drove
122	      on-hand to exactly zero."""
123	    if event.is_inbound:
124	        return [
125	            (event.inventory_account_id, amount),
126	            (event.offset_account_id, -amount),
127	        ]
128	    return [
129	        (event.offset_account_id, amount),
130	        (event.inventory_account_id, -(amount + residual)),
131	        (event.price_difference_account_id, residual),
132	    ]
133	
134	
135	def _lines_from_postings(
136	    postings: list[_SignedPosting], item_id: uuid.UUID
137	) -> list[JournalLineCreate]:
138	    """Collapse signed postings per account, drop zeros, and emit one-sided journal lines (D-017):
139	    a positive net is a debit, a negative net a credit. The item dimension rides every line so the
140	    COGS entry is attributable to the item (D-017 dimensions)."""
141	    net: dict[uuid.UUID, Decimal] = {}
142	    for account_id, signed in postings:
143	        net[account_id] = net.get(account_id, Decimal(0)) + signed
144	    lines: list[JournalLineCreate] = []
145	    for account_id, value in net.items():
146	        if value == 0:
147	            continue
148	        if value > 0:
149	            lines.append(
150	                JournalLineCreate(
151	                    account_id=account_id,
152	                    transaction_debit_amount=value,
153	                    item_id=item_id,
154	                )
155	            )
156	        else:
157	            lines.append(
158	                JournalLineCreate(
159	                    account_id=account_id,
160	                    transaction_credit_amount=-value,
161	                    item_id=item_id,
162	                )
163	            )
164	    return lines
165	
166	
167	__all__ = ["post_stock_valuation_journal"]

1	"""Inventory domain-event handlers (D-011/D-041) — the cross-module GR → stock-move bridge.
2	
3	Subscribes to ``procurement.goods_receipt.posted`` and creates one stock RECEIPT move per GR line in
4	the SAME transaction as the GR post (D-011 run_in_uow drains before commit). This is the SANCTIONED
5	cross-module mechanism (STRUCTURE §5): procurement must NOT import inventory's service, so the GR
6	post publishes ``GoodsReceiptPosted`` (a plain typed event — the only procurement file this handler
7	imports) and inventory reacts by calling its OWN ``stock_moves.create_move``. The mirror of the
8	existing inventory→finance pattern (inventory publishes StockValued, finance/handlers posts the
9	journal) — here procurement publishes, inventory handles.
10	
11	Each move passes ``valuation_offset_account_id`` = the GR/IR clearing account from the event, so the
12	move's costing event (StockValued) carries it as ``offset_account_id`` and finance's COGS handler
13	credits GR/IR — yielding Dr Inventory / Cr GR-IR (the three-way-match's clearing leg) instead of
14	the standalone price-difference offset. The whole chain — GR + N moves + N inventory-debit/GR-IR
15	journals — lands in ONE transaction; any failure (a closed receipt period trips a move's period
16	trigger, insufficient anything) rolls the WHOLE GR post back (D-020 all-or-nothing).
17	
18	The GR↔move linkage is recorded in DOCFLOW (GR document → 'moved_by' → move document, D-041), NOT a
19	cross-module FK — inventory owns the move, so it writes the edge from its side; procurement reads
20	the chain to render the flow. Procurement updates its own PO received_quantity + GR status in the
21	same transaction after publishing (it owns those tables); the handler never writes a procurement
22	row.
23	
24	Registration: ``app.main.register_event_handlers`` subscribes this at the app factory (the
25	deterministic D-011 registration seam), so the test harness re-registers after its per-test
26	``clear_subscriptions`` reset without a module re-import.
27	"""
28	
29	from __future__ import annotations
30	
31	from datetime import date
32	
33	from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
34	
35	from app.core import docflow
36	from app.modules.inventory.constants import MoveType
37	from app.modules.inventory.schemas import StockMoveCreate
38	from app.modules.inventory.service.stock_moves import create_move
39	from app.modules.procurement.constants import GR_MOVED_BY_STOCK_MOVE_LINK
40	from app.modules.procurement.events import GoodsReceiptPosted
41	
42	
43	async def receive_goods_receipt_moves(
44	    session: AsyncSession, event: GoodsReceiptPosted
45	) -> None:
46	    """Create the stock RECEIPT moves for a posted goods receipt (D-041), in the GR's transaction.
47	
48	    One move per GR line, each offsetting to the event's GR/IR clearing account so the costing
49	    event posts Dr Inventory / Cr GR-IR. Links the GR document to each move document ('moved_by') so
50	    the docflow chain shows PO → GR → move(s). Registered via ``app.main.register_event_handlers``
51	    (not an import-time ``@on``), so the test harness re-registers it after its per-test reset."""
52	    move_date = date.fromisoformat(event.move_date)
53	    for line in event.moves:
54	        move = await create_move(
55	            session,
56	            event.tenant_id,
57	            StockMoveCreate(
58	                move_type=MoveType.RECEIPT,
59	                item_id=line.item_id,
60	                quantity=line.quantity,
61	                to_bin_id=line.bin_id,
62	                lot_code=line.lot_code,
63	                serial_code=line.serial_code,
64	                move_date=move_date,
65	                unit_cost=line.unit_cost,
66	                reference=event.gr_number,
67	            ),
68	            valuation_offset_account_id=event.gr_ir_account_id,
69	        )
70	        await docflow.link_documents(
71	            session,
72	            event.tenant_id,
73	            predecessor=event.document_id,
74	            successor=move.document_id,
75	            link_type=GR_MOVED_BY_STOCK_MOVE_LINK,
76	        )

1	"""Finance's cross-module read interface (STRUCTURE §5).
2	
3	Finance is the bottom of the dependency order: every other module (inventory, sales, ...)
4	may import THIS file to read finance state synchronously, and finance imports no other
5	module's queries. Keep this surface thin and stable — it is a contract. The journal posting
6	flow (4.2) calls ``find_period_for_date`` to resolve an entry's period from its posting_date;
7	inventory/sales call ``get_period_status`` to refuse stock/sales documents dated into a closed
8	period before they reach the GL.
9	
10	Every function takes an explicit ``tenant_id`` and runs under the caller's tenant context, so
11	the D-007 filter applies on top of the explicit predicate — these are ordinary tenant-scoped
12	ORM reads, not a bypass.
13	"""
14	
15	import uuid
16	from datetime import date
17	from decimal import Decimal
18	
19	from sqlalchemy import func, select
20	from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
21	
22	from app.modules.finance.constants import (
23	    GR_IR_CLEARING,
24	    BillStatus,
25	    InvoiceStatus,
26	    PeriodStatus,
27	    RateKind,
28	    TaxDirection,
29	)
30	from app.modules.finance.models import (
31	    Account,
32	    CostCenter,
33	    Currency,
34	    CustomerInvoice,
35	    FiscalPeriod,
36	    JournalLine,
37	    ProfitCenter,
38	    TaxCode,
39	    VendorBill,
40	)
41	from app.modules.finance.service import fx as _fx
42	from app.modules.finance.service import posting_defaults as _posting_defaults
43	from app.modules.finance.service import tax as _tax
44	from app.modules.finance.service.tax import TaxCalculation
45	
46	
47	async def find_period_for_date(
48	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, on_date: date
49	) -> FiscalPeriod | None:
50	    """The fiscal period whose [start_date, end_date] (inclusive) covers ``on_date``, or
51	    None if no period does. Periods within a year are contiguous and non-overlapping (the
52	    service enforces that on generation), so at most one matches. This is the date->period
53	    lookup the journal uses on every posting (4.2)."""
54	    stmt = select(FiscalPeriod).where(
55	        FiscalPeriod.tenant_id == tenant_id,
56	        FiscalPeriod.start_date <= on_date,
57	        FiscalPeriod.end_date >= on_date,
58	    )
59	    return (await session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()
60	
61	
62	async def get_period_status(
63	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, on_date: date
64	) -> PeriodStatus | None:
65	    """The OPEN/CLOSED status of the period covering ``on_date``, or None when no period
66	    covers it. Callers posting financial or stock documents check this up front: None or
67	    CLOSED means the date is not in an open period and the document must be rejected
68	    (the DB-level period trigger on the journal in 4.2 is the bypass-proof backstop)."""
69	    period = await find_period_for_date(session, tenant_id, on_date)
70	    if period is None:
71	        return None
72	    return PeriodStatus(period.status)
73

75	async def account_exists(
76	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, code: str
77	) -> bool:
78	    """Whether an account with ``code`` exists in the tenant's chart of accounts. Lets
79	    another module validate a referenced account code without importing finance models."""
80	    stmt = select(Account.id).where(
81	        Account.tenant_id == tenant_id, Account.code == code
82	    )
83	    return (await session.execute(stmt)).first() is not None

87	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, account_id: uuid.UUID
88	) -> bool:
89	    """Whether an account with ``account_id`` exists in the tenant's chart of accounts.
90	
91	    The by-id companion to ``account_exists`` (sanctioned cross-module read, STRUCTURE §5 / D-029):
92	    inventory item categories reference finance GL accounts by OPAQUE uuid — never a cross-module
93	    FK — so the inventory service validates each referenced account id through this contract before
94	    storing it on a category. Tenant-scoped, so the D-007 filter applies on top of the explicit
95	    predicate (an ordinary tenant read, not a bypass)."""
96	    stmt = select(Account.id).where(
97	        Account.tenant_id == tenant_id, Account.id == account_id
98	    )
99	    return (await session.execute(stmt)).first() is not None

103	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, code: str
104	) -> bool:
105	    """Whether a currency with ISO ``code`` exists in the tenant's currency catalog.
106	
107	    Sanctioned cross-module read (STRUCTURE §5 / D-029): the procurement vendor master defaults a
108	    ``default_currency_code`` onto each vendor and validates it exists in finance through THIS
109	    contract before storing it — never a cross-module FK (finance is below procurement in the
110	    dependency order). Tenant-scoped, so the D-007 filter applies on top of the explicit predicate
111	    (an ordinary tenant read, not a bypass). Mirrors ``account_exists`` for the currency table."""
112	    stmt = select(Currency.id).where(

114	    )

148	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID

164	    resolve a line's tax code by its short key (e.g. ``'VAT20'``) through this contract rather than

170	def calculate_line_tax(
171	    base_amount: Decimal,
172	    tax_code: TaxCode,
173	    *,
174	    direction: TaxDirection,
175	    currency_code: str = "USD",
176	) -> TaxCalculation:
177	    """Tax one line consistently for any module (PLAN 4.4). A thin, pure re-export of
178	    ``service.tax.calculate_line_tax`` so Sales/Procurement compute net/tax/gross + the tax account
179	    exactly as finance does — one tax engine, no duplicated math. ``base_amount`` is the gross when

186	async def get_open_vendor_bills(
187	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, partner_id: uuid.UUID
188	) -> list[VendorBill]:
189	    """A partner's POSTED vendor bills that still have an open balance (PLAN 4.5, D-029). Exposed
190	    so procurement (later) can read a vendor's open AP without importing finance models — finance
191	    is the bottom of the dependency order (STRUCTURE §5). Keyed by the opaque ``partner_id``; never
192	    an FK to a vendor master. Ordered by due date so the oldest-due bills surface first."""
193	    stmt = (
194	        select(VendorBill)
195	        .where(
196	            VendorBill.tenant_id == tenant_id,
197	            VendorBill.partner_id == partner_id,
198	            VendorBill.status.in_(
199	                (BillStatus.POSTED.value, BillStatus.PARTIALLY_PAID.value)
200	            ),
201	            VendorBill.open_amount > 0,
202	        )

204	    )

208	def _open_customer_invoices_stmt(tenant_id: uuid.UUID, partner_id: uuid.UUID):
209	    """The SELECT for a partner's open customer invoices (PLAN 4.6, D-029): POSTED/PARTIALLY_PAID
210	    with a positive open balance, oldest-due first. Shared by the list + the balance sum so they
211	    can never disagree."""
212	    return (
213	        select(CustomerInvoice)
214	        .where(
215	            CustomerInvoice.tenant_id == tenant_id,
216	            CustomerInvoice.partner_id == partner_id,
217	            CustomerInvoice.status.in_(
218	                (InvoiceStatus.POSTED.value, InvoiceStatus.PARTIALLY_PAID.value)
219	            ),
220	            CustomerInvoice.open_amount > 0,
221	        )
222	        .order_by(CustomerInvoice.due_date)
223	    )
224	
225	
226	async def get_open_customer_invoices(
227	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, partner_id: uuid.UUID
228	) -> list[CustomerInvoice]:
229	    """A partner's POSTED customer invoices that still have an open balance (PLAN 4.6, D-029).
230	    Exposed so sales (later) can read a customer's open AR without importing finance models —
231	    finance is the bottom of the dependency order (STRUCTURE §5). Keyed by the opaque
232	    ``partner_id``; never an FK to a customer master. Ordered oldest-due first."""
233	    stmt = _open_customer_invoices_stmt(tenant_id, partner_id)
234	    return list((await session.execute(stmt)).scalars().all())
235	
236	
237	async def customer_open_balance(
238	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, partner_id: uuid.UUID
239	) -> Decimal:
240	    """The total still-owed AR for a partner across all open invoices (PLAN 4.6, D-029): the sum of
241	    their ``open_amount`` in transaction currency. Exposed so Sales' credit-limit block can ask
242	    finance "how much does this customer currently owe?" without importing finance models — the
243	    bottom-dependency contract (STRUCTURE §5). Sums in Python over the (typically small) open set so
244	    the exact-decimal MoneyType round-trips identically on both engines (D-015). Returns 0 for a
245	    partner with no open invoices."""
246	    invoices = await get_open_customer_invoices(session, tenant_id, partner_id)
247	    return sum((Decimal(str(inv.open_amount)) for inv in invoices), Decimal(0))
248	
249	
250	# --- Controlling: dimension validation + cost-centre balance (PLAN 4.7) -------
251	
252	
253	async def cost_center_exists(
254	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, cost_center_id: uuid.UUID
255	) -> bool:
256	    """Whether a cost centre with ``cost_center_id`` exists in the tenant. The journal posting flow
257	    calls this to validate a line's ``cost_center_id`` dimension before the line is written —
258	    service-level dimension integrity replacing the absent FK on the trigger-bearing journal-lines
259	    table (D-022)."""
260	    stmt = select(CostCenter.id).where(
261	        CostCenter.tenant_id == tenant_id, CostCenter.id == cost_center_id
262	    )
263	    return (await session.execute(stmt)).first() is not None
264

266	async def profit_center_exists(
267	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, profit_center_id: uuid.UUID
268	) -> bool:
269	    """Whether a profit centre with ``profit_center_id`` exists in the tenant. The companion to
270	    ``cost_center_exists`` for the journal line's ``profit_center_id`` dimension (D-022)."""
271	    stmt = select(ProfitCenter.id).where(
272	        ProfitCenter.tenant_id == tenant_id, ProfitCenter.id == profit_center_id
273	    )
274	    return (await session.execute(stmt)).first() is not None

277	async def cost_center_balance(
278	    session: AsyncSession,
279	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
280	    cost_center_id: uuid.UUID,
281	    period_id: uuid.UUID,
282	) -> Decimal:
283	    """The cost centre's NET functional balance for a fiscal period (PLAN 4.7): SUM over POSTED
284	    journal lines carrying this ``cost_center_id`` in ``period_id`` of (functional debit minus
285	    functional credit). This is the amount ``run_allocation`` redistributes — CO is a projection of
286	    the journal (D-021), so the balance is derived from journal lines, never a stored total.
287	    MoneyType type propagation keeps the SUM exact on both engines (D-015); returns 0 when none."""
288	    debit = func.coalesce(
289	        func.sum(JournalLine.functional_debit_amount), 0
290	    )
291	    credit = func.coalesce(
292	        func.sum(JournalLine.functional_credit_amount), 0
293	    )
294	    stmt = select(debit - credit).where(
295	        JournalLine.tenant_id == tenant_id,
296	        JournalLine.cost_center_id == cost_center_id,
297	        JournalLine.fiscal_period_id == period_id,
298	        JournalLine.is_posted.is_(True),
299	    )
300	    result = (await session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one()
301	    return Decimal(str(result)) if result is not None else Decimal(0)

307	async def account_balances(
308	    session: AsyncSession,
309	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
310	    *,
311	    date_to: date,
312	    date_from: date | None = None,
313	) -> dict[uuid.UUID, Decimal]:
314	    """Signed (debit-positive) net balance per account over the posted journal (D-021). The single
315	    statement base aggregate, exposed here so the reporting module (PLAN 13) builds its own views as
316	    projections of the SAME query the statements use — never a stored total. ``date_from`` bounds
317	    the range (a P&L-style window); omit it for cumulative-to-date balances (balance-sheet-style).
318	    Thin re-export of ``service.statements._account_balances`` — one aggregate, one index."""
319	    from app.modules.finance.service.statements import _account_balances
320	
321	    return await _account_balances(
322	        session, tenant_id, date_to=date_to, date_from=date_from
323	    )

327	    session: AsyncSession,
328	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
329	    *,
330	    date_to: date,
331	    date_from: date | None = None,
332	) -> Decimal:
333	    """Net income (revenue - expense, credit-positive so a profit is positive) over the range
334	    (D-021). Derived from ``account_balances`` + account types so reporting reads it as a projection
335	    of the journal — the same figure the balance sheet folds into retained earnings. Cumulative to
336	    ``date_to`` when ``date_from`` is omitted."""
337	    from app.modules.finance.service.statements import net_income_signed
338	    from app.modules.finance.service.statements.base import load_account_meta

341	        session, tenant_id, date_to=date_to, date_from=date_from

1	"""Goods-receipt business logic (PLAN 6.3, D-041): create DRAFT against a PO, post (the heart),
2	cancel. Reads live in ``goods_receipt_reads.py`` (split at the 400-line cap); the package
3	``__init__`` re-exports both halves as one surface.
4	
5	A goods receipt records physical receipt of PO goods. ``create_goods_receipt`` writes a DRAFT
6	(validates the PO is receivable, each line belongs to it, quantity is within the open quantity,
7	the bin + item check out, the item matches the PO line) and claims the GR number at creation
8	(D-040). ``post_goods_receipt`` is the heart: in ONE transaction it raises each PO line's
9	received_quantity, advances the PO status (PARTIALLY_RECEIVED / RECEIVED), links docflow PO→GR, and
10	PUBLISHES ``GoodsReceiptPosted`` — inventory's handler creates the stock RECEIPT moves (Dr Inventory
11	/ Cr GR-IR via the valuation-offset override) and finance posts the journals, all in this same
12	transaction. A closed receipt period trips a move's journal trigger and rolls the WHOLE post back.
13	
14	Cross-module rule (STRUCTURE §5 / D-041): procurement NEVER calls inventory's service — the stock
15	effect goes through the event bus. Procurement reads the GR/IR clearing account via finance/queries
16	and validates bins via inventory/queries (downward reads), updates its OWN PO/GR rows, and lets
17	inventory's handler own the moves. The GR↔move link is the docflow 'moved_by' edge the handler
18	writes, not a cross-module FK.
19	"""
20

23	import uuid
24	from dataclasses import dataclass
25	from datetime import date, datetime
26	from decimal import Decimal
27	
28	from sqlalchemy import select
29	from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

32	from app.core.events import publish

37	    GOODS_RECEIPT_DOC_TYPE,

39	    GOODS_RECEIPT_NUMBER_PREFIX,
40	    GOODS_RECEIPT_SEQUENCE_NAME,
41	    PO_RECEIVED_BY_GR_LINK,
42	    GoodsReceiptStatus,
43	    PurchaseOrderStatus,
44	)
45	from app.modules.procurement.events import GoodsReceiptMove, GoodsReceiptPosted

47	    GoodsReceipt,

59	# A PO is receivable once committed (SENT) or while partially received; an APPROVED PO is also
60	# accepted (a tenant may receive against an approved-but-not-yet-marked-sent order). DRAFT /
61	# PENDING_APPROVAL / REJECTED / CANCELLED / RECEIVED / CLOSED cannot start a NEW receipt.
62	_RECEIVABLE_PO_STATUSES = frozenset(
63	    {
64	        PurchaseOrderStatus.APPROVED,
65	        PurchaseOrderStatus.SENT,
66	        PurchaseOrderStatus.PARTIALLY_RECEIVED,
67	    }
68	)

71	@dataclass(frozen=True)
72	class _ReceiptLineInput:
73	    """One validated receipt line: the PO line it receives against, the snapshot item/cost from that
74	    line, the target bin, the received quantity, optional lot/serial and the inspection flag."""
75	
76	    purchase_order_line_id: uuid.UUID
77	    item_id: uuid.UUID
78	    unit_cost: Decimal
79	    bin_id: uuid.UUID
80	    received_quantity: Decimal
81	    lot_code: str | None
82	    serial_code: str | None
83	    requires_inspection: bool

86	async def _require_receivable_po(
87	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, po_id: uuid.UUID
88	) -> PurchaseOrder:
89	    po = await session.get(PurchaseOrder, po_id)
90	    if po is None or po.tenant_id != tenant_id:
91	        raise ValidationFailedError(
92	            message="Referenced purchase order does not exist",
93	            code="procurement.purchase_order_not_found",
94	            details={"purchase_order_id": str(po_id)},
95	        )
96	    if PurchaseOrderStatus(po.status) not in _RECEIVABLE_PO_STATUSES:
97	        raise ValidationFailedError(
98	            message=f"A {po.status} purchase order cannot receive goods",
99	            code="procurement.po_not_receivable",
100	            details={"purchase_order_id": str(po_id), "status": po.status},
101	        )
102	    return po
103

105	async def _validate_receipt_line(
106	    session: AsyncSession,
107	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
108	    po_id: uuid.UUID,
109	    po_lines: dict[uuid.UUID, PurchaseOrderLine],
110	    payload_line: object,
111	) -> _ReceiptLineInput:
112	    """Validate one receipt line against its PO line: the line belongs to the PO, the quantity is
113	    > 0 and within the still-open quantity (over-receipt REJECTED 422 in v1), and the target bin
114	    exists in inventory (D-029). Snapshots the item + unit_cost from the PO line."""
115	    po_line = po_lines.get(payload_line.purchase_order_line_id)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
116	    if po_line is None:
117	        raise ValidationFailedError(
118	            message="The receipt line does not belong to this purchase order",
119	            code="procurement.gr_line_not_on_po",
120	            details={
121	                "purchase_order_id": str(po_id),
122	                "purchase_order_line_id": str(
123	                    payload_line.purchase_order_line_id  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
124	                ),
125	            },
126	        )
127	    qty = validate_quantity(payload_line.received_quantity)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
128	    open_qty = Decimal(str(po_line.quantity)) - Decimal(str(po_line.received_quantity))
129	    if qty > open_qty:
130	        raise ValidationFailedError(
131	            message="The received quantity exceeds the purchase-order line's open quantity",
132	            code="procurement.over_receipt",
133	            details={
134	                "purchase_order_line_id": str(po_line.id),
135	                "open_quantity": str(open_qty),
136	                "received_quantity": str(qty),
137	            },
138	        )
139	    bin_id = payload_line.bin_id  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
140	    if not await inventory_queries.bin_exists(session, tenant_id, bin_id):
141	        raise ValidationFailedError(
142	            message="The target bin does not exist in inventory",
143	            code="procurement.gr_bin_not_found",
144	            details={"bin_id": str(bin_id)},
145	        )
146	    requires_inspection = payload_line.requires_inspection  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
147	    return _ReceiptLineInput(
148	        purchase_order_line_id=po_line.id,
149	        item_id=po_line.item_id,
150	        unit_cost=Decimal(str(po_line.unit_cost)),
151	        bin_id=bin_id,
152	        received_quantity=qty,
153	        lot_code=payload_line.lot_code,  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
154	        serial_code=payload_line.serial_code,  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
155	        requires_inspection=bool(requires_inspection),
156	    )
157

159	async def create_goods_receipt(
160	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, payload: GoodsReceiptCreate
161	) -> GoodsReceipt:
162	    """Create a DRAFT goods receipt against a PO (PLAN 6.3). Validates the PO is receivable, each
163	    line belongs to it, the quantity is within the open quantity (over-receipt → 422
164	    procurement.over_receipt), and the bin exists. Snapshots the vendor + per-line item/unit_cost
165	    from the PO and claims the GR number at creation (D-040). No stock moves yet — that is POST."""
166	    if not payload.lines:
167	        raise ValidationFailedError(
168	            message="A goods receipt needs at least one line",
169	            code="procurement.gr_no_lines",
170	        )
171	    po = await _require_receivable_po(session, tenant_id, payload.purchase_order_id)
172	    po_lines = {line.id: line for line in await _po_lines(session, tenant_id, po.id)}
173	    receipt_date = payload.receipt_date or date.today()
174	
175	    validated = [
176	        await _validate_receipt_line(session, tenant_id, po.id, po_lines, line)
177	        for line in payload.lines
178	    ]
179	
180	    gr_id = uuid.uuid4()
181	    document = await docflow.register_document(
182	        session,
183	        tenant_id,
184	        GOODS_RECEIPT_DOC_TYPE,
185	        gr_id,
186	        doc_number=None,
187	        status=GoodsReceiptStatus.DRAFT.value,
188	    )
189	    number = await claim_document_number(
190	        session,
191	        tenant_id,
192	        sequence_name=GOODS_RECEIPT_SEQUENCE_NAME,
193	        prefix=GOODS_RECEIPT_NUMBER_PREFIX,
194	        padding=GOODS_RECEIPT_NUMBER_PADDING,
195	        on_date=receipt_date,
196	    )
197	
198	    gr = GoodsReceipt(
199	        id=gr_id,
200	        tenant_id=tenant_id,
201	        document_id=document.id,
202	        gr_number=number,
203	        status=GoodsReceiptStatus.DRAFT.value,
204	        purchase_order_id=po.id,
205	        vendor_id=po.vendor_id,
206	        warehouse_id=payload.warehouse_id,
207	        receipt_date=receipt_date,
208	        notes=payload.notes,
209	    )
210	    session.add(gr)
211	    for index, line in enumerate(validated, start=1):
212	        session.add(
213	            GoodsReceiptLine(
214	                tenant_id=tenant_id,
215	                gr_id=gr_id,
216	                line_number=index,
217	                purchase_order_line_id=line.purchase_order_line_id,
218	                item_id=line.item_id,
219	                bin_id=line.bin_id,
220	                received_quantity=line.received_quantity,
221	                unit_cost=line.unit_cost,
222	                lot_code=line.lot_code,
223	                serial_code=line.serial_code,
224	                requires_inspection=line.requires_inspection,
225	            )
226	        )
227	    await session.flush()
228	    await docflow.set_document_status(
229	        session, tenant_id, document.id, doc_number=number, status=GoodsReceiptStatus.DRAFT.value
230	    )
231	    return gr
232	
233	
234	async def post_goods_receipt(
235	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, gr_id: uuid.UUID
236	) -> GoodsReceipt:
237	    """Post a DRAFT goods receipt (PLAN 6.3, D-041) — the heart. In ONE transaction: raise each PO
238	    line's received_quantity, advance the PO status (PARTIALLY_RECEIVED / RECEIVED), link docflow
239	    PO→GR, set the GR POSTED, and PUBLISH ``GoodsReceiptPosted`` so inventory's handler creates the
240	    stock RECEIPT moves (Dr Inventory / Cr GR-IR) and finance posts the journals — all here, before
241	    commit (D-011). A closed receipt period trips a move's journal trigger and rolls it ALL back.
242	
243	    Idempotent re-post is rejected (a POSTED GR is terminal — corrected by a reversing GR/return,
244	    Phase 7). The caller commits via uow; the published event is drained in that same uow."""
245	    gr = await get_goods_receipt(session, tenant_id, gr_id)
246	    status = GoodsReceiptStatus(gr.status)
247	    if status == GoodsReceiptStatus.POSTED:
248	        raise ConflictError(
249	            message="The goods receipt is already posted",
250	            code="procurement.gr_already_posted",
251	            details={"goods_receipt_id": str(gr_id)},
252	        )
253	    if status != GoodsReceiptStatus.DRAFT:
254	        raise ConflictError(
255	            message=f"A {gr.status} goods receipt cannot be posted",
256	            code="procurement.gr_not_postable",
257	            details={"goods_receipt_id": str(gr_id), "status": gr.status},
258	        )
259	
260	    # Resolve the GR/IR clearing account up front (finance/queries, downward) — raises 422 if the
261	    # tenant has not mapped it, so the post fails before any state changes (D-041).
262	    gr_ir_account_id = await finance_queries.gr_ir_clearing_account(session, tenant_id)
263	
264	    lines = await get_goods_receipt_lines(session, tenant_id, gr_id)
265	    po_lines = {line.id: line for line in await _po_lines(session, tenant_id, gr.purchase_order_id)}
266	
267	    moves: list[GoodsReceiptMove] = []
268	    for line in lines:
269	        po_line = po_lines[line.purchase_order_line_id]
270	        po_line.received_quantity = Decimal(str(po_line.received_quantity)) + Decimal(
271	            str(line.received_quantity)
272	        )
273	        moves.append(
274	            GoodsReceiptMove(
275	                item_id=line.item_id,
276	                bin_id=line.bin_id,
277	                quantity=Decimal(str(line.received_quantity)),
278	                unit_cost=Decimal(str(line.unit_cost)),
279	                lot_code=line.lot_code,
280	                serial_code=line.serial_code,
281	                requires_inspection=line.requires_inspection,
282	            )
283	        )
284	
285	    await _advance_po_status(session, tenant_id, gr.purchase_order_id, po_lines.values())
286	
287	    gr.status = GoodsReceiptStatus.POSTED.value
288	    gr.posted_at = datetime.now()
289	    await session.flush()
290	    await docflow.set_document_status(
291	        session, tenant_id, gr.document_id, status=GoodsReceiptStatus.POSTED.value
292	    )
293	    # Link PO document → GR document ('received_by') for the docflow chain (the GR→move edges are
294	    # written by inventory's handler when it creates the moves — D-041).
295	    po = await session.get(PurchaseOrder, gr.purchase_order_id)
296	    if po is not None:
297	        await docflow.link_documents(
298	            session,
299	            tenant_id,
300	            predecessor=po.document_id,
301	            successor=gr.document_id,
302	            link_type=PO_RECEIVED_BY_GR_LINK,
303	        )
304	
305	    # Publish AFTER procurement's own writes settle: inventory's handler creates the moves with the
306	    # GR/IR offset and finance posts the journals, all drained in this same uow (D-011/D-041).
307	    publish(
308	        session,
309	        GoodsReceiptPosted(
310	            tenant_id=tenant_id,
311	            goods_receipt_id=gr.id,
312	            gr_number=gr.gr_number,
313	            document_id=gr.document_id,
314	            warehouse_id=gr.warehouse_id,
315	            move_date=gr.receipt_date.isoformat(),
316	            gr_ir_account_id=gr_ir_account_id,
317	            moves=tuple(moves),
318	        ),
319	    )
320	    return gr
321	
322	
323	async def cancel_goods_receipt(
324	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, gr_id: uuid.UUID
325	) -> GoodsReceipt:
326	    """Cancel a DRAFT goods receipt (PLAN 6.3). A POSTED GR is TERMINAL — it has moved stock and
327	    posted journals, so it is corrected by a reversing GR / a return (Phase 7 RMA), never cancelled
328	    (v1 has no reverse-GR; documented). Cancelling a DRAFT moves nothing."""
329	    gr = await get_goods_receipt(session, tenant_id, gr_id)
330	    if GoodsReceiptStatus(gr.status) != GoodsReceiptStatus.DRAFT:
331	        raise ConflictError(
332	            message=f"A {gr.status} goods receipt cannot be cancelled",
333	            code="procurement.gr_not_cancellable",
334	            details={"goods_receipt_id": str(gr_id), "status": gr.status},
335	        )
336	    gr.status = GoodsReceiptStatus.CANCELLED.value
337	    await session.flush()
338	    await docflow.set_document_status(
339	        session, tenant_id, gr.document_id, status=GoodsReceiptStatus.CANCELLED.value
340	    )
341	    return gr
342	
343	
344	async def _po_lines(
345	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, po_id: uuid.UUID
346	) -> list[PurchaseOrderLine]:
347	    stmt = select(PurchaseOrderLine).where(
348	        PurchaseOrderLine.tenant_id == tenant_id, PurchaseOrderLine.po_id == po_id
349	    )
350	    return list((await session.execute(stmt)).scalars().all())
351	
352	
353	async def _advance_po_status(
354	    session: AsyncSession,
355	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
356	    po_id: uuid.UUID,
357	    po_lines,
358	) -> None:
359	    """Advance the PO status after a receipt raised the lines' received_quantity (PLAN 6.3):
360	    RECEIVED when every line is fully received (received >= ordered), else PARTIALLY_RECEIVED. The
361	    PO + lines are already loaded/mutated in this session, so this reads the in-memory state."""
362	    fully_received = all(
363	        Decimal(str(line.received_quantity)) >= Decimal(str(line.quantity)) for line in po_lines
364	    )
365	    po = await session.get(PurchaseOrder, po_id)
366	    if po is None or po.tenant_id != tenant_id:
367	        return
368	    new_status = (
369	        PurchaseOrderStatus.RECEIVED if fully_received else PurchaseOrderStatus.PARTIALLY_RECEIVED
370	    )
371	    po.status = new_status.value
372	    await session.flush()
373	    await docflow.set_document_status(session, tenant_id, po.document_id, status=new_status.value)

1	"""Domain events procurement PUBLISHES (D-011/D-041). Declarative data only — no logic, no models —
2	so inventory's ``handlers.py`` may import these typed classes (the STRUCTURE §5 events.py allowance:
3	an event carries no behaviour, so a subscriber in another module imports it without any logic).
4	
5	``GoodsReceiptPosted`` is the SANCTIONED cross-module mechanism for the goods-receipt → stock-move
6	effect (D-041). Procurement OWNS the GR document and its PO; it MUST NOT call inventory's service
7	directly (STRUCTURE §5 forbids importing another module's service). So the GR POST publishes this
8	event carrying everything inventory needs to create the stock RECEIPT moves — one
9	``GoodsReceiptMove`` per GR line (item, target bin, quantity, the snapshot unit cost, lot/serial,
10	the GR/IR
11	clearing offset account, the inspection flag) plus the move_date and the GR's core_documents id for
12	docflow linkage. Inventory's ``handlers.py`` subscribes, creates each move via its OWN service with
13	``valuation_offset_account_id`` = the GR/IR account (so the costing event credits GR/IR), and links
14	GR document → 'moved_by' → move document. The handler shares the session, so the moves + their
15	inventory-debit/GR-IR journals land in the SAME transaction as the GR post — all-or-nothing
16	(D-011/D-020): a closed period or any handler failure rolls the WHOLE GR post back.
17	
18	Procurement updates its OWN tables (the PO received_quantity, the GR status/posted_at) in that same
19	transaction AFTER publishing; it does NOT need the move ids back — the GR↔move link is the durable
20	docflow edge the handler writes, not a cross-module FK column (D-041).
21	"""
22

6	``router.include_router``, no second mount in main.py):

66	async def _commit[T](session: SessionDep, work: Callable[[], Awaitable[T]]) -> T:
67	    """Run a service call inside the D-011 uow, returning its ORM result refreshed in the async
68	    context so a sync ``model_validate`` never trips MissingGreenlet (twin of inventory _commit)."""
69	    holder: list[T] = []
70	
71	    async def _work() -> None:
72	        result = await work()
73	        await session.refresh(result)
74	        holder.append(result)
75	
76	    await run_in_uow(session, _work)
77	    return holder[0]

3	The DATA-DRIVEN release rule: a requisition / PO whose total is AT OR ABOVE the active threshold for
4	its document_type requires approval before it can advance (submit → stays SUBMITTED / send → goes
5	PENDING_APPROVAL); below the threshold it auto-approves. This is a single-characteristic (amount)
6	rule per the s4hana-parity Procurement section — multi-characteristic / multi-step release
7	strategies

1	"""Inventory's cross-module read interface (STRUCTURE §5).
2	
3	Inventory sits just above finance in the dependency order: every module above it (procurement,
4	sales, manufacturing) may import THIS file to read inventory state synchronously, and inventory
5	imports only finance/queries downward. Keep this surface thin and stable — it is a contract; it is
6	the ONLY inventory file other modules import.
7	
8	For PLAN 5.1 it exposes the item-master reads those modules will need: existence checks, the
9	item's base UoM and costing method, and the category's GL-account wiring (so the COGS handler can
10	resolve where to post when stock issues land in 5.2+). PLAN 5.2 adds the ON-HAND projection reads
11	(``total_on_hand``, ``on_hand_by_bin``, ``on_hand_by_lot``) — what sales ATP and procurement will
12	call: they read the MAINTAINED ``inv_stock_quants`` projection (D-036), an indexed aggregate, never
13	an unbounded SUM over the move history (PERFORMANCE §1).
14	
15	Every function takes an explicit ``tenant_id`` and runs under the caller's tenant context, so the
16	D-007 filter applies on top of the explicit predicate — ordinary tenant-scoped reads, not a bypass.
17	"""
18	
19	import uuid
20	from decimal import Decimal
21	
22	from sqlalchemy import func, select
23	from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
24	
25	from app.modules.inventory.constants import CostingMethod
26	from app.modules.inventory.models import (
27	    Bin,
28	    CostLayer,
29	    Item,
30	    ItemCategory,
31	    ItemValuation,
32	    StockQuant,
33	)
34	
35	
36	async def get_item(
37	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
38	) -> Item | None:
39	    """The item with ``item_id`` in the tenant, or None. Lets another module read an item's master
40	    fields (name, type, base UoM, costing method) without importing inventory models directly."""
41	    stmt = select(Item).where(Item.tenant_id == tenant_id, Item.id == item_id)
42	    return (await session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()
43	
44	
45	async def item_exists(
46	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
47	) -> bool:
48	    """Whether an item with ``item_id`` exists in the tenant. The cheap existence check a sales or
49	    procurement line uses to validate its item_id dimension (the inventory analogue of finance's
50	    ``account_exists_by_id``)."""
51	    stmt = select(Item.id).where(Item.tenant_id == tenant_id, Item.id == item_id)
52	    return (await session.execute(stmt)).first() is not None
53	
54	
55	async def get_costing_method(
56	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
57	) -> CostingMethod | None:
58	    """The item's costing method (D-020), or None if the item does not exist. The costing engine
59	    (5.3) reads this to choose moving-average vs FIFO; exposed so other modules can too."""
60	    stmt = select(Item.costing_method).where(
61	        Item.tenant_id == tenant_id, Item.id == item_id
62	    )
63	    value = (await session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()
64	    return CostingMethod(value) if value is not None else None
65	
66	
67	async def get_base_uom(
68	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
69	) -> uuid.UUID | None:
70	    """The item's base UoM id (the unit it is stored/costed in), or None if the item does not
71	    exist. A document line in another UoM converts to this base via ``service.convert_quantity``."""
72	    stmt = select(Item.base_uom_id).where(
73	        Item.tenant_id == tenant_id, Item.id == item_id
74	    )
75	    return (await session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()
76	
77	
78	async def get_category_accounts(
79	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
80	) -> tuple[uuid.UUID | None, uuid.UUID | None, uuid.UUID | None] | None:
81	    """The GL-account wiring (inventory, COGS, price-difference) of an item's category (D-020),
82	    or None if the item does not exist. The COGS handler (5.2+) resolves where to post a goods
83	    issue from this tuple. Any element may be None when the category has not wired that account
84	    yet — the issuing flow validates presence before it posts. One join, item -> category."""
85	    stmt = (
86	        select(
87	            ItemCategory.inventory_account_id,
88	            ItemCategory.cogs_account_id,
89	            ItemCategory.price_difference_account_id,
90	        )
91	        .join(Item, Item.category_id == ItemCategory.id)
92	        .where(Item.tenant_id == tenant_id, Item.id == item_id)
93	    )
94	    row = (await session.execute(stmt)).first()
95	    return (row[0], row[1], row[2]) if row is not None else None
96	
97	
98	async def bin_exists(
99	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, bin_id: uuid.UUID
100	) -> bool:
101	    """Whether a bin with ``bin_id`` exists in the tenant (PLAN 6.3). A goods receipt validates the
102	    target bin its stock lands in through this contract (D-029) rather than importing inventory
103	    models. Existence only — the move engine re-checks the bin is in an ACTIVE warehouse when it
104	    posts, so a receipt against an inactive-warehouse bin still fails (at post), loud."""
105	    stmt = select(Bin.id).where(Bin.tenant_id == tenant_id, Bin.id == bin_id)
106	    return (await session.execute(stmt)).first() is not None
107	
108	
109	# --- On-hand projection reads (PLAN 5.2) --------------------------------------
110	# These read the MAINTAINED inv_stock_quants projection (D-036), kept in lock-step with the move
111	# ledger so on-hand is an indexed aggregate over a small current-state table, not a SUM over
112	# unbounded move history (PERFORMANCE §1). MoneyType/QuantityType propagation keeps the SUM exact on
113	# both engines (D-015); ``func.coalesce(..., 0)`` makes an item with no stock read 0, not None.
114	
115	
116	async def total_on_hand(
117	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
118	) -> Decimal:
119	    """Total on-hand quantity of an item across ALL bins and lots (PLAN 5.2). The number sales ATP
120	    starts from. Reads inv_stock_quants (the maintained projection), index-served by
121	    ``(tenant_id, item_id)``."""
122	    stmt = select(func.coalesce(func.sum(StockQuant.on_hand_qty), 0)).where(
123	        StockQuant.tenant_id == tenant_id, StockQuant.item_id == item_id
124	    )
125	    return (await session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one()
126	
127	
128	async def on_hand(
129	    session: AsyncSession,
130	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
131	    item_id: uuid.UUID,
132	    bin_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
133	    lot_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
134	) -> Decimal:
135	    """On-hand quantity of an item, optionally narrowed to one bin and/or one lot (PLAN 5.2). With
136	    no bin/lot this is ``total_on_hand``; with a bin it is that bin's stock; with a lot it is that
137	    lot's stock (in the bin if also given). Reads the maintained projection."""
138	    stmt = select(func.coalesce(func.sum(StockQuant.on_hand_qty), 0)).where(
139	        StockQuant.tenant_id == tenant_id, StockQuant.item_id == item_id
140	    )
141	    if bin_id is not None:
142	        stmt = stmt.where(StockQuant.bin_id == bin_id)
143	    if lot_id is not None:
144	        stmt = stmt.where(StockQuant.lot_id == lot_id)
145	    return (await session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one()
146	
147	
148	async def on_hand_by_bin(
149	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
150	) -> dict[uuid.UUID, Decimal]:
151	    """Per-bin on-hand totals for an item (PLAN 5.2): ``{bin_id: qty}`` summed across that bin's
152	    lots. Bins with zero net stock are absent (the move service deletes a quant when it hits 0, so
153	    the projection holds only live stock). What a bin-level stock-overview screen reads."""
154	    stmt = (
155	        select(StockQuant.bin_id, func.sum(StockQuant.on_hand_qty))
156	        .where(StockQuant.tenant_id == tenant_id, StockQuant.item_id == item_id)
157	        .group_by(StockQuant.bin_id)
158	    )
159	    rows = (await session.execute(stmt)).all()
160	    return {row[0]: row[1] for row in rows}
161	
162	
163	async def on_hand_by_lot(
164	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
165	) -> dict[uuid.UUID, Decimal]:
166	    """Per-lot on-hand totals for a LOT-tracked item (PLAN 5.2): ``{lot_id: qty}`` summed across
167	    bins. Quants with a NULL lot (fungible stock) are excluded — this view is for tracked items
168	    where lot traceability matters."""
169	    stmt = (
170	        select(StockQuant.lot_id, func.sum(StockQuant.on_hand_qty))
171	        .where(
172	            StockQuant.tenant_id == tenant_id,
173	            StockQuant.item_id == item_id,
174	            StockQuant.lot_id.is_not(None),
175	        )
176	        .group_by(StockQuant.lot_id)
177	    )
178	    rows = (await session.execute(stmt)).all()
179	    return {row[0]: row[1] for row in rows}
180	
181	
182	# --- Valuation reads (PLAN 5.3, D-020/D-037) ----------------------------------
183	# These read the VALUE SSOT (inv_item_valuations for moving-average, inv_cost_layers for FIFO), kept
184	# in lock-step with every move in the same transaction (D-037). The inventory-value dashboard KPI
185	# and
186	# valuation reports read these. MoneyType/QuantityType propagation keeps the SUMs exact (D-015).
187	
188	
189	async def item_value(
190	    session: AsyncSession,
191	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
192	    item_id: uuid.UUID,
193	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
194	) -> Decimal:
195	    """The current total inventory VALUE of an item (PLAN 5.3), optionally narrowed to one
196	    warehouse.
197	
198	    For a MOVING_AVERAGE item this sums ``inv_item_valuations.total_value``; for a FIFO item it sums
199	    ``remaining_qty × unit_cost`` over the live cost layers. An item uses exactly one method, so the
200	    other source contributes 0. The FIFO product is summed in PYTHON (each factor already a typed
201	    Decimal) rather than ``func.sum(qty × cost)``, because multiplying two scaled-integer columns on
202	    SQLite yields a ×10^12 value that the MoneyType result processor cannot un-scale (D-015 trigger
203	    discipline: SQL never multiplies two stored money/quantity columns)."""
204	    valuation_stmt = select(
205	        func.coalesce(func.sum(ItemValuation.total_value), 0)
206	    ).where(ItemValuation.tenant_id == tenant_id, ItemValuation.item_id == item_id)
207	    layer_stmt = select(CostLayer.remaining_qty, CostLayer.unit_cost).where(
208	        CostLayer.tenant_id == tenant_id,
209	        CostLayer.item_id == item_id,
210	        CostLayer.remaining_qty > 0,
211	    )
212	    if warehouse_id is not None:
213	        valuation_stmt = valuation_stmt.where(ItemValuation.warehouse_id == warehouse_id)
214	        layer_stmt = layer_stmt.where(CostLayer.warehouse_id == warehouse_id)
215	    mav_value = Decimal((await session.execute(valuation_stmt)).scalar_one())
216	    fifo_value = sum(
217	        (Decimal(qty) * Decimal(cost) for qty, cost in (await session.execute(layer_stmt)).all()),
218	        Decimal(0),
219	    )
220	    return mav_value + fifo_value
221	
222	
223	async def valuation_summary(
224	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID
225	) -> dict[uuid.UUID, Decimal]:
226	    """Total inventory value per item across the tenant (PLAN 5.3): ``{item_id: value}`` — the
227	    moving-average totals plus the FIFO live-layer values, merged per item. What the inventory-value
228	    dashboard KPI sums. The moving-average totals are grouped in SQL; the FIFO layer products are
229	    summed in Python per item (D-015: no SQL multiply of two scaled money/quantity columns).
230	    PERFORMANCE §6: two reads, no per-item N+1."""
231	    mav_rows = (
232	        await session.execute(
233	            select(ItemValuation.item_id, func.sum(ItemValuation.total_value))
234	            .where(ItemValuation.tenant_id == tenant_id)
235	            .group_by(ItemValuation.item_id)
236	        )
237	    ).all()
238	    layer_rows = (
239	        await session.execute(
240	            select(CostLayer.item_id, CostLayer.remaining_qty, CostLayer.unit_cost).where(
241	                CostLayer.tenant_id == tenant_id, CostLayer.remaining_qty > 0
242	            )
243	        )
244	    ).all()
245	    totals: dict[uuid.UUID, Decimal] = {}
246	    for item_id_, value in mav_rows:
247	        if value is not None:
248	            totals[item_id_] = totals.get(item_id_, Decimal(0)) + Decimal(value)
249	    for item_id_, qty, cost in layer_rows:
250	        totals[item_id_] = totals.get(item_id_, Decimal(0)) + Decimal(qty) * Decimal(cost)
251	    return totals
252	
253	
254	async def current_unit_cost(
255	    session: AsyncSession,
256	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
257	    item_id: uuid.UUID,
258	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
259	) -> Decimal:
260	    """The item's current per-unit BOOK cost in a warehouse (PLAN 5.4): the moving-average
261	    ``avg_unit_cost`` for a MOVING_AVERAGE item, or the weighted average of the live FIFO layers for
262	    a FIFO item — the SAME source a value-neutral transfer uses for its ledger cost
263	    (costing._current_unit_cost). A positive count variance enters stock at this cost so the value
264	    added matches the book cost (rather than an arbitrary entry price). Returns 0 when no
265	    valuation/layer exists yet (an item the system thinks is empty, counted positive — the
266	    adjustment then enters at 0 cost, a quantity-only correction with no value impact, which the
267	    operator can re-cost via a later receipt). The FIFO layer product is summed in PYTHON (D-015: no
268	    SQL multiply of two scaled money/quantity columns). One read for the MAV row, one for the FIFO
269	    layers (no per-layer N+1)."""
270	    valuation = (
271	        await session.execute(
272	            select(ItemValuation.avg_unit_cost).where(
273	                ItemValuation.tenant_id == tenant_id,
274	                ItemValuation.item_id == item_id,
275	                ItemValuation.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
276	            )
277	        )
278	    ).scalar_one_or_none()
279	    if valuation is not None:
280	        return Decimal(valuation)
281	    rows = (
282	        await session.execute(
283	            select(CostLayer.remaining_qty, CostLayer.unit_cost).where(
284	                CostLayer.tenant_id == tenant_id,
285	                CostLayer.item_id == item_id,
286	                CostLayer.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
287	                CostLayer.remaining_qty > 0,
288	            )
289	        )
290	    ).all()
291	    total_qty = sum((Decimal(qty) for qty, _cost in rows), Decimal(0))
292	    total_value = sum((Decimal(qty) * Decimal(cost) for qty, cost in rows), Decimal(0))
293	    return (total_value / total_qty) if total_qty > 0 else Decimal(0)

1	"""Inventory master data (PLAN 5.1): item categories, UoMs, per-item UoM conversions, the item
2	master, and the lot/serial instance tables.
3	
4	One file in the ``models/`` package (STRUCTURE §3: the combined models.py was split into a
5	models/ package when PLAN 5.2's warehouse/bin/move/quant tables would have pushed it over the
6	400-line cap, the finance models/ precedent). This file owns the 5.1 MASTER tables; the 5.2
7	warehouse/bin/move/quant STOCK tables live in ``models/stock.py``.
8	
9	Design decisions baked in here:
10	
11	- **Costing wiring on the category (D-020 + D-029).** ``ItemCategory`` carries the default
12	  costing method AND the three GL accounts COGS/valuation posting will need —
13	  ``inventory_account_id``, ``cogs_account_id``, ``price_difference_account_id`` — as OPAQUE
14	  ``sa.Uuid`` columns, NOT cross-module FKs (D-029): finance owns those accounts; the inventory
15	  service validates each id exists via ``finance/queries.py`` when set, and the journal-line
16	  precedent already stores finance dimension ids without an FK on a cross-module table. They are
17	  NULLABLE on the category (a SERVICE-only category needs none); a STOCKED item's category must
18	  carry them before that item can post moves — validated when moves land (5.2+), not in 5.1.
19	
20	- **costing_method on the item (D-020).** Defaulted from the category at create but STORED on the
21	  item, because the item is the costing unit and D-020 lets it change only while no stock exists.
22	
23	- **UoM convention (the chosen one of the two the task offered): per-item BASE + ALTERNATES.**
24	  Each item has ONE ``base_uom_id``; quantities are stored/costed in the base UoM. An
25	  ``UomConversion`` row expresses an ALTERNATE UoM for that item as ``factor_to_base`` —
26	  multiplying a quantity in the alternate UoM by the factor yields the base-UoM quantity (an
27	  item whose base is EA and has BOX with factor 12 means 1 BOX = 12 EA). ``UNIQUE(tenant_id,
28	  item_id, alt_uom_id)`` — one factor per (item, alternate). This is the standard ERP shape
29	  (S/4HANA's alternative-UoM table): simpler than a full from/to graph, and base<->alt and
30	  alt<->alt conversions all derive from the single per-alternate factor (service.convert_quantity).
31	
32	- **Lot / SerialNumber are MASTER tables only for 5.1.** They are defined so the schema is
33	  receipt-ready, but instances are CREATED during receipts (5.2+); 5.1 ships no CRUD for them.
34	
35	All tables follow the D-007 composite-tenant-FK backstop: ``tenant_unique()`` on every table
36	referenced by a child, ``tenant_fk()`` composites for every cross-row link so a child can never
37	point at another tenant's parent. Enum-valued columns are plain ``sa.String`` storing the
38	StrEnum's UPPER_SNAKE value (the core/finance convention, no ``sa.Enum``); the service maps
39	to/from the constants classes.
40	"""
41	
42	import uuid
43	from datetime import datetime
44	from decimal import Decimal
45	
46	import sqlalchemy as sa
47	from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column
48	
49	from app.core.models import (
50	    AuditMixin,
51	    Base,
52	    TenantMixin,
53	    TimestampMixin,
54	    UuidPKMixin,
55	    tenant_fk,
56	    tenant_unique,
57	)
58	from app.core.money import QuantityType
59	from app.modules.inventory.constants import CostingMethod, LotStatus, TrackingMode
60	
61	
62	class ItemCategory(UuidPKMixin, TenantMixin, AuditMixin, TimestampMixin, Base):
63	    """A grouping of items sharing a default costing method and GL-account wiring (D-020/D-029).
64	
65	    ``default_costing_method`` is copied onto each item at create (the item then owns its method).
66	    The three account ids are OPAQUE finance GL-account uuids (D-029): NULLABLE here (a category of
67	    SERVICE items needs none), validated-present-in-finance only when supplied, and required on a
68	    STOCKED item's category before that item can post stock moves (enforced in 5.2+). Audited
69	    (D-010): category configuration drives where COGS lands."""
70	
71	    __tablename__ = "inv_item_categories"
72	    __table_args__ = (
73	        sa.UniqueConstraint("tenant_id", "code", name="uq_inv_item_categories_tenant_id_code"),
74	        tenant_unique(),
75	        tenant_fk("adm_tenants"),
76	    )
77	
78	    code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(sa.String(40), nullable=False)
79	    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(sa.String(200), nullable=False)
80	    default_costing_method: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
81	        sa.String(20),
82	        nullable=False,
83	        default=CostingMethod.MOVING_AVERAGE.value,
84	        server_default="MOVING_AVERAGE",
85	    )
86	    # Opaque finance GL-account ids (D-029): no cross-module FK; the service validates each via
87	    # finance/queries when set. Dr COGS / Cr inventory at goods issue; price_difference absorbs
88	    # moving-average zero-quantity rounding flushes (D-020).
89	    inventory_account_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=True)
90	    cogs_account_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=True)
91	    price_difference_account_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=True)
92	
93	
94	class Uom(UuidPKMixin, TenantMixin, AuditMixin, TimestampMixin, Base):
95	    """A unit-of-measure definition (e.g. EA, KG, BOX). Just the unit's identity — base-ness is
96	    NOT here: which UoM is base is decided PER ITEM (``Item.base_uom_id``), and alternate-UoM
97	    factors live on ``UomConversion``. Audited (D-010): master data."""
98	
99	    __tablename__ = "inv_uoms"
100	    __table_args__ = (
101	        sa.UniqueConstraint("tenant_id", "code", name="uq_inv_uoms_tenant_id_code"),
102	        tenant_unique(),
103	        tenant_fk("adm_tenants"),
104	    )
105	
106	    code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(sa.String(20), nullable=False)
107	    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(sa.String(100), nullable=False)

1	"""Purchase-requisition business logic (PLAN 6.2): create, submit (approval-gated), approve/reject,
2	update, cancel + reads.
3	
4	Lifecycle (constants.RequisitionStatus): DRAFT → SUBMITTED → APPROVED/REJECTED, or
5	DRAFT/SUBMITTED/APPROVED → CANCELLED, or APPROVED → CONVERTED (the convert services flip this). The
6	SUBMIT step evaluates the REQUISITION value-threshold rule on the estimated total
7	(Σ qty × estimated_unit_cost over the lines): at-or-above the active threshold the requisition STAYS
8	SUBMITTED awaiting an approver; below it the submit auto-advances to APPROVED (the data-driven rule,
9	D-040). A line without an estimate contributes 0 to the total — an all-estimate-less requisition has
10	total 0, which is below any positive threshold, so it auto-approves.
11	
12	The PR number is claimed AT CREATION (D-040) and the document is registered in core_documents then.
13	Idempotency (D-013) is owned by the endpoints.
14	"""
15	
16	from __future__ import annotations
17	
18	import uuid
19	from datetime import datetime
20	from decimal import Decimal
21	
22	from sqlalchemy import select
23	from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
24	
25	from app.core import docflow
26	from app.core.exceptions import ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationFailedError
27	from app.core.pagination import (
28	    DEFAULT_LIMIT,
29	    OrderKey,
30	    SortDirection,
31	    filter_fingerprint,
32	    paginate,
33	)
34	from app.core.schemas import Page
35	from app.modules.procurement.constants import (
36	    REQUISITION_DOC_TYPE,
37	    REQUISITION_NUMBER_PADDING,
38	    REQUISITION_NUMBER_PREFIX,
39	    REQUISITION_SEQUENCE_NAME,
40	    ApprovalDocumentType,
41	    RequisitionStatus,
42	)
43	from app.modules.procurement.models import PurchaseRequisition, PurchaseRequisitionLine
44	from app.modules.procurement.schemas import RequisitionCreate, RequisitionUpdate
45	from app.modules.procurement.service import approvals
46	from app.modules.procurement.service._shared import (
47	    claim_document_number,
48	    validate_currency,
49	    validate_item,
50	    validate_quantity,
51	)

53	
54	async def get_requisition(
55	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, requisition_id: uuid.UUID
56	) -> PurchaseRequisition:
57	    req = await session.get(PurchaseRequisition, requisition_id)
58	    if req is None or req.tenant_id != tenant_id:
59	        raise NotFoundError(
60	            message="Requisition not found", code="procurement.requisition_not_found"
61	        )
62	    return req
63	
64	
65	async def get_requisition_lines(
66	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, requisition_id: uuid.UUID
67	) -> list[PurchaseRequisitionLine]:
68	    stmt = (
69	        select(PurchaseRequisitionLine)
70	        .where(
71	            PurchaseRequisitionLine.tenant_id == tenant_id,
72	            PurchaseRequisitionLine.requisition_id == requisition_id,
73	        )
74	        .order_by(PurchaseRequisitionLine.line_number)
75	    )
76	    return list((await session.execute(stmt)).scalars().all())
77	
78	
79	async def _validate_lines(
80	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, payload_lines: list
81	) -> None:
82	    if not payload_lines:
83	        raise ValidationFailedError(
84	            message="A requisition needs at least one line",
85	            code="procurement.requisition_no_lines",
86	        )
87	    for line in payload_lines:
88	        await validate_item(session, tenant_id, line.item_id)
89	        validate_quantity(line.quantity)
90	        await validate_currency(session, tenant_id, line.currency_code)
91	
92	
93	async def create_requisition(
94	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, payload: RequisitionCreate
95	) -> PurchaseRequisition:
96	    """Create a DRAFT requisition + lines (PLAN 6.2). Validates every item exists, qty > 0 and the
97	    line currency exists in finance; claims the PR number and registers the document AT CREATION
98	    (D-040)."""
99	    await _validate_lines(session, tenant_id, payload.lines)
100	
101	    requisition_id = uuid.uuid4()
102	    document = await docflow.register_document(
103	        session,
104	        tenant_id,
105	        REQUISITION_DOC_TYPE,
106	        requisition_id,
107	        doc_number=None,
108	        status=RequisitionStatus.DRAFT.value,
109	    )
110	    number = await claim_document_number(
111	        session,
112	        tenant_id,
113	        sequence_name=REQUISITION_SEQUENCE_NAME,
114	        prefix=REQUISITION_NUMBER_PREFIX,
115	        padding=REQUISITION_NUMBER_PADDING,
116	        on_date=datetime.now().date(),
117	    )
118	    req = PurchaseRequisition(
119	        id=requisition_id,
120	        tenant_id=tenant_id,
121	        document_id=document.id,
122	        requisition_number=number,
123	        status=RequisitionStatus.DRAFT.value,
124	        requested_by=payload.requested_by,
125	        needed_by_date=payload.needed_by_date,
126	        notes=payload.notes,
127	    )
128	    session.add(req)
129	    for index, line in enumerate(payload.lines, start=1):
130	        session.add(
131	            PurchaseRequisitionLine(
132	                tenant_id=tenant_id,
133	                requisition_id=requisition_id,
134	                line_number=index,
135	                item_id=line.item_id,
136	                description=line.description,
137	                quantity=validate_quantity(line.quantity),
138	                uom_id=line.uom_id,
139	                estimated_unit_cost=(
140	                    None
141	                    if line.estimated_unit_cost is None
142	                    else Decimal(str(line.estimated_unit_cost))
143	                ),
144	                currency_code=line.currency_code,
145	            )
146	        )
147	    await session.flush()
148	    await docflow.set_document_status(
149	        session, tenant_id, document.id, doc_number=number, status=RequisitionStatus.DRAFT.value
150	    )
151	    return req
152	
153	
154	async def update_requisition(
155	    session: AsyncSession,
156	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
157	    requisition_id: uuid.UUID,
158	    payload: RequisitionUpdate,
159	) -> PurchaseRequisition:
160	    """Partial header update of a DRAFT requisition (PLAN 6.2). When ``lines`` is supplied they are
161	    replaced wholesale (revalidated + renumbered). Only a DRAFT requisition is editable."""
162	    req = await get_requisition(session, tenant_id, requisition_id)
163	    if RequisitionStatus(req.status) != RequisitionStatus.DRAFT:
164	        raise ConflictError(
165	            message="Only a draft requisition can be edited",
166	            code="procurement.requisition_not_draft",
167	            details={"status": req.status},
168	        )
169	    data = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
170	    new_lines = data.pop("lines", None)
171	    for field, value in data.items():
172	        setattr(req, field, value)
173	    if new_lines is not None:
174	        await _validate_lines(session, tenant_id, payload.lines)
175	        for existing in await get_requisition_lines(session, tenant_id, requisition_id):
176	            await session.delete(existing)
177	        await session.flush()
178	        for index, line in enumerate(payload.lines, start=1):
179	            session.add(
180	                PurchaseRequisitionLine(
181	                    tenant_id=tenant_id,
182	                    requisition_id=requisition_id,
183	                    line_number=index,
184	                    item_id=line.item_id,
185	                    description=line.description,
186	                    quantity=validate_quantity(line.quantity),
187	                    uom_id=line.uom_id,
188	                    estimated_unit_cost=(
189	                        None
190	                        if line.estimated_unit_cost is None
191	                        else Decimal(str(line.estimated_unit_cost))
192	                    ),
193	                    currency_code=line.currency_code,
194	                )
195	            )
196	    await session.flush()
197	    return req
198	
199	
200	async def _estimated_total(
201	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, requisition_id: uuid.UUID
202	) -> tuple[Decimal, str | None]:
203	    """The requisition's estimated total (Σ qty × estimated_unit_cost) and the currency of its
204	    lines (the first line's — v1 requisitions are single-currency in practice). A line with no
205	    estimate contributes 0."""
206	    lines = await get_requisition_lines(session, tenant_id, requisition_id)
207	    total = Decimal(0)
208	    currency: str | None = None
209	    for line in lines:
210	        if currency is None:
211	            currency = line.currency_code
212	        if line.estimated_unit_cost is not None:
213	            total += Decimal(str(line.quantity)) * Decimal(str(line.estimated_unit_cost))
214	    return total, currency
215	
216	
217	async def submit_requisition(
218	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, requisition_id: uuid.UUID
219	) -> PurchaseRequisition:
220	    """Submit a DRAFT requisition (PLAN 6.2). Evaluates the REQUISITION approval threshold on the
221	    estimated total: at-or-above ⇒ status SUBMITTED (awaits an approver); below ⇒ auto APPROVED.
222	    Idempotent-ish only in that re-submitting a non-draft is a conflict."""
223	    req = await get_requisition(session, tenant_id, requisition_id)
224	    if RequisitionStatus(req.status) != RequisitionStatus.DRAFT:
225	        raise ConflictError(
226	            message="Only a draft requisition can be submitted",
227	            code="procurement.requisition_not_draft",
228	            details={"status": req.status},
229	        )
230	    total, currency = await _estimated_total(session, tenant_id, requisition_id)
231	    needs_approval = currency is not None and await approvals.requires_approval(
232	        session, tenant_id, ApprovalDocumentType.REQUISITION, total, currency
233	    )
234	    new_status = RequisitionStatus.SUBMITTED if needs_approval else RequisitionStatus.APPROVED
235	    req.status = new_status.value
236	    await session.flush()
237	    await docflow.set_document_status(
238	        session, tenant_id, req.document_id, status=new_status.value
239	    )
240	    return req
241	
242	
243	async def decide_requisition(
244	    session: AsyncSession,
245	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
246	    requisition_id: uuid.UUID,
247	    *,
248	    approved: bool,
249	) -> PurchaseRequisition:
250	    """Approve or reject a SUBMITTED requisition (PLAN 6.2, the procurement.requisition.approve
251	    action). Only a SUBMITTED requisition awaiting approval can be decided."""
252	    req = await get_requisition(session, tenant_id, requisition_id)
253	    if RequisitionStatus(req.status) != RequisitionStatus.SUBMITTED:
254	        raise ConflictError(
255	            message="Only a submitted requisition can be approved or rejected",
256	            code="procurement.requisition_not_submitted",
257	            details={"status": req.status},
258	        )
259	    new_status = RequisitionStatus.APPROVED if approved else RequisitionStatus.REJECTED
260	    req.status = new_status.value
261	    await session.flush()
262	    await docflow.set_document_status(
263	        session, tenant_id, req.document_id, status=new_status.value
264	    )
265	    return req
266	
267	
268	async def cancel_requisition(
269	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, requisition_id: uuid.UUID
270	) -> PurchaseRequisition:
271	    """Cancel a requisition (PLAN 6.2). Allowed from DRAFT/SUBMITTED/APPROVED; a CONVERTED one
272	    cannot be cancelled (it has a successor) and a terminal one cannot be re-cancelled."""
273	    req = await get_requisition(session, tenant_id, requisition_id)
274	    status = RequisitionStatus(req.status)
275	    if status in (
276	        RequisitionStatus.CONVERTED,
277	        RequisitionStatus.REJECTED,
278	        RequisitionStatus.CANCELLED,
279	    ):
280	        raise ConflictError(
281	            message=f"A {req.status} requisition cannot be cancelled",
282	            code="procurement.requisition_not_cancellable",
283	            details={"status": req.status},
284	        )
285	    req.status = RequisitionStatus.CANCELLED.value
286	    await session.flush()
287	    await docflow.set_document_status(
288	        session, tenant_id, req.document_id, status=RequisitionStatus.CANCELLED.value
289	    )
290	    return req
291	
292	
293	async def list_requisitions(
294	    session: AsyncSession,
295	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
296	    *,
297	    status: RequisitionStatus | None = None,
298	    requested_by: uuid.UUID | None = None,
299	    cursor: str | None = None,
300	    limit: int = DEFAULT_LIMIT,
301	) -> Page[PurchaseRequisition]:
302	    """Keyset-paginated requisition list, newest first (D-014). status + requested_by filters fold
303	    into the cursor fingerprint; the (tenant, status) index serves the filtered page."""
304	    stmt = select(PurchaseRequisition).where(PurchaseRequisition.tenant_id == tenant_id)
305	    if status is not None:
306	        stmt = stmt.where(PurchaseRequisition.status == RequisitionStatus(status).value)
307	    if requested_by is not None:
308	        stmt = stmt.where(PurchaseRequisition.requested_by == requested_by)
309	    return await paginate(
310	        session,
311	        stmt,
312	        order_by=[OrderKey(PurchaseRequisition.created_at, SortDirection.DESC)],
313	        pk=PurchaseRequisition.id,
314	        cursor=cursor,
315	        limit=limit,
316	        filters=filter_fingerprint(status, requested_by),
317	    )

15	from starlette.types import ASGIApp, Message, Receive, Scope, Send
16	
17	from app.core.audit import actor_user_id_ctx, request_id_ctx, request_ip_ctx
18	from app.core.config import Settings, get_settings
19	from app.core.docflow_router import router as docflow_router

24	from app.core.schemas import ErrorBody, ErrorEnvelope
25	from app.core.security_router import router as security_router
